Asheville & Black Mountain Real Estate
Browse real estate in Asheville, Black Mountain, and surrounding areas. Buy or sell homes with Asheville's trusted local real estate agents.

THE AREA
Waynesville - Primary Community, NC
View all Waynesville homes for sale Waynesville, NC is a town located southwest of Asheville. It’s the county seat of Haywood County and the biggest town west of Asheville before the North Carolina-Tennessee border. In addition to a warm and walkable downtown, the larger Waynesville area also contains quiet neighborhoods and rural communities. It is considered part of the Asheville metropolitan area, being only 45 minutes from the Asheville city center.

YOUR INTRODUCTION
At Freestone Properties, we pride ourselves on offering an innovative, technology-driven real estate experience while never losing sight of what matters most—our clients and our community. Founded in 2016 by Scott and Lisa Russell, our firm was built on a passion for the outdoors and a deep appreciation for the dynamic real estate landscape of the Asheville and Black Mountain areas. As a family-owned company and now in partnership with Allen Tate/Beverly-Hanks, we combine exceptional client service with the resources and expertise of the region’s leading brokerage—always ensuring your needs come first.
